title: Image Captioning · Application and System Observability
description: Health, throughput, latency and hardware correlation for the CPU-only image captioning app.

options.content:
# Image-captioning service: application and system observability
**CPU-only BLIP captioner (Streamlit + prometheus_client) and host metrics (node_exporter)**. Refresh 5 s. Every x-axis is time. Read top to bottom: health, throughput, latency, workload, hardware.  
Colours follow the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette. Blue solid = single mode, orange dashed = bulk mode. Line styles and the ▲ / ▼ symbols carry the meaning in greyscale or print too.

panels.title: App status · scrape up/down
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape the app's /metrics endpoint on its last attempt. Blue ▲ UP = healthy, orange ▼ DOWN = scrape failed.

panels.title: Host status · node_exporter up/down
panels.description: Whether the node_exporter endpoint (system metrics) is reachable.

panels.title: Model · loaded?
panels.description: 1 once the BLIP model has been loaded into memory by the app.

panels.title: App uptime · since start
panels.description: Time since the app process started (now minus the start timestamp gauge). A sudden reset means the app restarted.

panels.title: In-flight requests · now
panels.description: Requests currently being processed (single plus bulk). A bulk ZIP counts as one request while it runs.

panels.title: Firing alerts · now
panels.description: Number of Prometheus alerts currently firing. Orange = at least one alert needs attention.

panels.title: 2 · Throughput and workload: how much is being processed?
Throughput · images/min, linear
panels.description: Successful captions per minute. Bulk ZIPs run at roughly one image per inference time (about 50 img/min on this CPU) while single uploads stay near zero until a user clicks. x: time.

panels.title: Failed images · images/min, linear
panels.description: Images that raised an error (unreadable file, corrupt ZIP entry, model failure) per minute. Anything above zero deserves a look. x: time.

panels.title: Concurrency · count, linear
panels.description: In-flight requests per mode and the number of images still waiting in the current bulk batch. Pending counts down to zero as a ZIP finishes. x: time.

panels.title: Images captioned per client · cumulative
panels.description: Total successful captions per client IP and session ID since the app started. Shows who is generating the load.

panels.title: Images captioned · cumulative count, linear
panels.description: Running total of successful captions per mode since the app started. Steep segments are bulk runs. x: time.

panels.title: Errors by type · cumulative
panels.description: Count of errors since app start, by mode and exception type.

panels.title: 3 · Latency: how long does each image take?
Inference latency percentiles · seconds, linear
panels.description: Time the model spends generating one caption, as p50 (typical), p95 and p99 (slow tail), estimated from histogram buckets. Rising p95 under bulk load signals CPU contention. x: time.

panels.title: Mean inference latency by mode · seconds, linear
panels.description: Average seconds per image, computed as rate(sum)/rate(count) of the inference histogram. Compares single against bulk. x: time.

panels.title: End-to-end request p95 · seconds, LOG10
panels.description: 95th percentile time for a whole user request. A single upload takes about a second; a bulk ZIP takes minutes, so the axis is logarithmic to show both. A request appears once it finishes. x: time.

panels.title: Where time goes · mean ms per image, LOG10
panels.description: Mean preprocessing time against mean model inference time per image. Inference dominates by two orders of magnitude, so the axis is logarithmic. x: time.

panels.title: 4 · Workload characteristics: what is being processed?
Mean caption length · characters, linear
panels.description: Average length of generated captions (Summary _sum / _count). Longer captions mean more decoding steps and more time. x: time.

panels.title: Mean image size · megapixels, linear
panels.description: Average pixel count of input images (Summary _sum / _count), in millions of pixels. x: time.

panels.title: Upload volume · bytes/s, linear
panels.description: Rate of image data received by the app, per mode. x: time.

panels.title: 5 · System resources: correlate with bulk uploads
CPU vs bulk activity · % of host capacity, linear
panels.description: Host CPU (all processes) and the app's own CPU, both as a percentage of total machine capacity, with the shaded steps (right axis) marking when a bulk request is running. CPU rises and falls with the bulk steps, which links the application load to the hardware. x: time.

panels.title: Host memory used · %, linear
panels.description: Share of host RAM in use (1 minus available/total). Loading the model and running bulk batches push this up. x: time.

panels.title: App memory · bytes, linear
panels.description: Resident memory of the app process against the size of the model's parameters. The gap is runtime and activation overhead. x: time.

panels.title: Disk I/O · bytes/s, linear
panels.description: Host disk read and write throughput, summed over physical devices. Spikes during model load or ZIP extraction. x: time.

panels.title: Root disk used · %, linear
panels.description: Share of the root filesystem in use. A slow climb is normal after downloading model weights. x: time.

panels.title: Load average · runnable processes, linear
panels.description: 1-minute and 5-minute load averages. Values above the number of CPU cores mean work is queuing for the CPU. x: time.
